name: browser-operator-kit
description: Descriptor-driven Chrome Eye, native macOS Hand, and guarded Eye-to-Hand-to-Eye web operations.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:demo-extension
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run validate && npm run check:public && npm run check:syntax && npm test
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-adapter.mjs demo/adapter/automation.adapter.json && node scripts/validate-manifest.mjs dist/demo-extension/manifest.json
scripts.check:syntax: node --check src/operator-server.js && node --check src/operator-server-entry.js && node --check src/web-command-runner.js && node --check src/native-input-controller.js && node --check src/operation-catalog.js && node --check scripts/build-extension.mjs && node --check extension/eye-service-worker.js && node --check extension/eye/engine.js && node --check extension/sidepanel/sidepanel.js && python3 -m py_compile python/browser_operator_kit/*.py
